Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fixer round 2, topic r10-advisor (group R10-ADVISOR, PR #2572, branch fix/r10-advisor, PR head 441d19932f40475ddc0420f3b67ba8d90202eb2c = reviewed code head 21eeb5b2 plus a CI autofix "pin killed mutants"; your previous code is refs/heads/handoff/r10-advisor, body refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-advisor; start from the PR head if it is ahead of the handoff). Read the last "Fix review: blocked 21eeb5b2..." comment on PR #2572 in full (gh api repos/tvofi/heatpump_optimizer/issues/2572/comments), including its ev/ description: blocking B1 (harness: config-attack): price_tiles refreshes ONE tile per scheduled solve (_maybe_refresh_price_tile, cursor over 3 specs), so target_minus_1 and target_plus_1 come from different solves and different start times; the card's convexity predicate (cost >= save - 1 in degreeRow) assumes the two published means are exactly antisymmetric. The body's `days` arm prices both tiles from one midnight solve and only checks sign monotonicity, never the card's degreeRow predicate. The reviewer's rotation probe replays production (one tile per solve, fixed cadence): the card is hidden on 14/40 days at 30 min, 3/40 at 60, 12/40 at 90, 30/40 at 120; even with both tiles every solve it is concave up to 2.3/month on 11/40 days (the held estimator is not convex across intraday starts). optimization_interval is a user setting (10-120 min, default 30, config_flow.py ~1730), so the premise breaks at defaults. Fix soundly (architecturally, not a threshold nudge): make the card's published pair robust to the sampling that production really does (for example price both tiles from the same solve/start, or smooth/pair them consistently, or make the predicate and estimator agree across starts), then change the harness so the `days` arm replays production's rotation at 30/60/120 min cadences and applies the card's actual degreeRow predicate, with a null control (a constant flat price must show no card gap) and the finder's harness at both ends. Failing test first, mutation proof, GATE_SCOPE auto, tests/structure.py before push, no budget raise (stop and report if one is needed). Re-measure every figure in the body at your own head (## Head names the new code head), merge current origin/main (never rebase) and confirm git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head> is clean. The reviewer's probe is on the review ref (git fetch origin review/2572, evidence/ and ev/tools/rotation_probe.py): reuse it, do not re-derive. Any earlier verdict does not carry. Seat-selftest mutants take per-file ids; self-tests build repos only via tests/throwaway_git.py.
